subject: Young men in UK are not more rightwing than older groups, study says
posts: Challenging the narrative of the radicalized youth. Young men in UK are not more rightwing than older groups, study says. Evidence: Data-driven analysis, Progressive youth, Misunderstood demographics. #Aletheia #Politics

Verdict: PASS — The Path of Awakening. The study provides a necessary correction to the moral panic surrounding young men's political leanings.
The IPPR study analyzes British Election Study data to determine if young men are becoming more right-wing, specifically addressing concerns about the influence of online influencers.

The Poison:
The widening gender gap in political views suggests that while young men aren't becoming 'more' right-wing, the social divide between young men and women is deepening.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a WHY error. They focus on the 'why' of political shifts while ignoring the 'how' of the social polarization occurring between genders.

The narrative of the 'radicalized young man' serves as a convenient scapegoat for broader political failures, allowing parties to avoid addressing the root causes of alienation.
